craft_notes: Sthāyin: threefold remainder. Rows: catalogue kept whole. Rejected: glossing kāmya — killed: deferred by text. Read aloud: counted tread.

lines: Daily, feastly, longed-for: threefold the leftover walk.
The last is the striver's own — here left unjudged.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyam iti trividhaṃ śeṣavartanam antyaṃ ca sādhakasyaiva tat na iha niścetavyam
